messages:
annie-docs: Quick sanity-check thread for v1->v2 migration docs. Need a short checklist we can hand to PMs and a CI smoke job.

omar-eng: I'm happy to run snippet smoke on staging. Which files?

annie-docs: All /v1/* doc pages, sample apps READMEs, js/py/go snippets that reference client.v1 or old embed aliases. Also streaming and webhook examples.

jess-sdk: I'll grep SDK and samples today. Command I'm using: `rg "client\.v1" --hidden --glob '!node_modules' || true`

priya-qa: Proposal: add CI job docs/migrate-sanity that runs 4 snippets (py/js/go/ts), checks exit code, verifies embedding vector length when applicable, and validates streaming callback signature. Fails upload artifacts to artifacts/migrate-sanity/1764448888/.

annie-docs: Nice. Add an assert for embed length: expected dims map in docs -> if mismatch, fail and include model name in output.

jess-sdk: For streaming: old signature was `onmessage(chunk)`; v2 uses `onChunk({delta, role})`. I'll update TS example and leave a short migration note.

omar-eng: Web ops: can we 302 /v1/* -> /docs/migrate-v2 for 60 days? That will reduce churn for customers.

webops-bot: ticket WEB-9002 created by @omar-eng: add redirect rule /v1/* -> /docs/migrate-v2 (302) for 60d then 301.

priya-qa: Kicking off CI run now. Will post pass/fail summary and attach logs.

annie-docs: Draft short deprecation copy for banners: "Redwood API v1 will be retired 2026-05-15. Migrate to v2: /docs/migrate-v2" Keep it short and link to migration guide.

jess-sdk: I'll add a CHANGELOG entry and emit console.warn from v1 shim with the retirement date to surface in dev environments.

omar-eng: If CI finds infra issues (timeouts/kernel crashes), tag eng-runtime and we triage. Only correctness failures should block the announcement.

priya-qa: CI results: 4/4 snippets ran; 1 warning for embedding dim mismatch on sample-app (expected 1536, got 1536). false alarm—looks consistent. Streaming example adjusted and re-run. Artifacts: artifacts/migrate-sanity/1764448888/report.txt

annie-docs: Great. I'll open final PRs to update docs and add the banner once SDK/samples PRs land. Owners: docs @annie-docs, SDK @jess-sdk, CI @priya-qa, webops @omar-eng. Target: merge by Tue EOD, announce Wed morning.

jess-sdk: Done a first pass PRs for samples. Leaving comments on a couple of edge-case snippets (webhook auth header differences).

annie-docs: Thanks team :white_check_mark:
